title: VICE gate sound back-pressure regulator
body: When the SID is the audio timing source, the VICE pacing gate paces the worker to the audio device draining its sample buffer (regulator 1), taking precedence over vsync.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Buffer at or over the high-water mark => worker blocks (advances nothing)
Buffer has room => worker advances a chunk
Warp skips both sound and vsync (highest precedence)
No active audio device => falls through to the vsync regulator
